install_benchmarks_for_jobs: run the InstallCommand to install benchmarks for specified jobs using a chosen compiler toolchain
install_required_tools: install required tools for a benchmark job by calling install_tool on each hook in the job
force_reinstall_benchmark: force reinstall a benchmark even if already installed by passing the --force flag to the install command
initialize_env_vars_for_job: initialize environment variables for a benchmark job with a specified gcc or clang toolchain config
verify_benchmark_installation: verify whether a benchmark is already installed by calling verify_install with the job install script
